example_sentences_in_bangla: এখন বাজারে বেগুনে আগুন, সব সবজির দাম বেড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The market is on fire in the eggplant now, all vegetable prices have soared.
During inflation, even eggplants catch fire in price.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali agrarian life, where eggplants are a staple cheap vegetable; 'fire in the eggplant' symbolizes even basic items becoming unaffordably expensive due to market fluctuations.
note: Reflects economic hardships in everyday Bengali conversation.
